behavioural_job.statement: Give the Commercial Director a structured read on whether affiliate-driven volume holds when promotion depth is reduced on a bounded comparison set — so the scale-vs-hold decision is made on observed demand elasticity rather than on a pattern that is consistent with price dependency but not yet confirmed as such.

intervention.statement: Reduce offer / discount depth on a client-nominated comparison set of products or regions, against a matched set that stays at current depth, so the single variable of promotion depth can be read against volume, margin and repeat behaviour. The client holds the commercial lever; the agency owns the activation architecture around it. Nothing else changes: affiliate content approach, listing content, creator roster, media weight, price list, stock, SKU set, affiliate budget and other promotional mechanics are held as they are.
intervention.controlled_variable: Offer / discount depth on the affiliate-attributed comparison set (one reduced level, approved by the client)

preservation_constraints.item: Affiliate content approach and listing content
preservation_constraints.why: Any new content direction, creative or listing proof would add a second variable, and a volume change could then be consistent with either the content or the offer depth.
A change in who is active would alter reach and audience quality alongside offer depth, so the two could not be separated.
A change in paid media would alter traffic composition and volume independently of offer depth.
A list-price change would mix price-point sensitivity with promotion-depth sensitivity.
A stock constraint would suppress volume for a reason unrelated to offer depth and give a false read of demand.
Adding or removing products on either group during the test would change the mix being compared.
The programme continues business-wide at current investment; varying budget alongside offer depth would leave the result consistent with either.

preservation_constraints.item: Other promotional mechanics (vouchers, bundles, platform promotions) where feasible
preservation_constraints.why: A second promotional change on either group would blur the read of offer depth; any that cannot be held are logged as deviations.

content_roles.job: Existing affiliate content continues unchanged on the comparison set and carries buyers to purchase as it does today. It is not a lever in this test: any change to its approach, creative or proof would add a second variable to the offer-depth read.

creator_role.job: Creator roster and creator briefs are held as they are for the test; creators are given no new role. Whether stronger product-value content can further reduce promotional dependence is a possible next decision, not part of this intervention.

platform_roles.job: Held constant: existing affiliate content continues unchanged. Only the offer depth the buyer meets at purchase differs between the comparison set and the matched set.
Held constant: no new proof or content is added. The listing shows the reduced offer on the comparison set and the current offer on the matched set; nothing else changes.
Held constant and observation-only: tracks whether buyers acquired at reduced offer depth return, read directionally because of the long re-purchase cycle.

platform_roles.environment: Affiliate programme (business-wide, outside the comparison set)
platform_roles.job: Continues at current offer depth and incentive structure so the business keeps its volume and the comparison has a stable baseline.

execution_choices.question: Should the test change anything other than offer depth?
execution_choices.recommended: No. Offer depth is the only controlled variable; affiliate content approach, creative, listing content, creator roster, media weight, price list, stock, SKU set and affiliate budget stay as they are.
execution_choices.why: The decision is whether volume is promotion-dependent. A second change would make any volume movement consistent with either change, so the test could not settle the decision.
execution_choices.alternative_not_chosen: Pairing the reduction with new value-led content or new listing proof

execution_choices.question: Should one reduced offer depth be tested or several at once?
execution_choices.recommended: One reduced depth on the comparison set, approved by the client finance team against its own margin recovery target.
execution_choices.why: Several depths would split the comparison set further and thin each cell, which is hard to read from aggregated indexed data, the only format the client can share.
execution_choices.alternative_not_chosen: Several depths tested simultaneously across sub-sets

execution_choices.question: Should the affiliate incentive mechanic be restructured or only the offer depth reduced within it?
execution_choices.recommended: Reduce depth within the existing mechanic; do not restructure commission or incentive terms during this test.
execution_choices.why: Restructuring the incentive at the same time would change creator motivation alongside offer depth. The incentive review stays a planning exercise until the result is known.
execution_choices.alternative_not_chosen: Shifting to a full-price or lower-discount commission structure on the comparison set at the same time

execution_choices.question: How should other promotional mechanics be handled on both groups?
execution_choices.recommended: Hold vouchers, bundles and platform-run promotions at current settings where feasible; log every one that cannot be held as a deviation.
execution_choices.why: Offer depth can only be read cleanly if no other promotional lever moves on either group. Where a lever is outside the client's control, it is recorded so the result can be qualified.
execution_choices.alternative_not_chosen: Leaving other promotional mechanics unmonitored during the test

execution_choices.question: When should the test run, and for how long?
execution_choices.recommended: Test window to be agreed against the actual commercial calendar. Avoid major promotional, platform or seasonal events that would materially confound the read. Duration should be sufficient to produce a readable sample and should not be hard-coded before a real pilot is scoped.
execution_choices.why: The calendar, and what counts as a readable sample, can only be judged against a real pilot's commercial calendar and volumes. Fixing either now would be a guess.
execution_choices.alternative_not_chosen: Fixing a start date and duration before a real pilot is scoped

execution_owner_asks: Lead the decision-framing and test-design conversations with the client, and record the agreed decision question, tolerance, sets and single reduced depth before anything launches.
Run the Readiness & Control Gate as a go / no-go: no launch until every enabler is confirmed in writing and deployment is verified on the comparison set only.
Hold the control plan for every held-constant, keep the deviation log, and escalate the same day a condition moves.
Deliver the activation readout (delivery and test conditions only, not the verdict) and a next-activation recommendation that is conditional on the reconciled result.

agency_deliverables.purpose: The agreed brief for the commercial test: the decision it serves, the single variable, what is held constant, and what each team applies. Co-authored with the client; the depth and thresholds are the client's.
tasks: Activation plan: sequence, owners, dates and dependencies, with the test window to be agreed against the actual commercial calendar
Offer-depth implementation brief: exactly what each team applies, where, from when, to which set (depth value supplied by the client)
Record the agreed decision question and tolerance before launch
agency_deliverables.done_when: The client has agreed the brief in writing, including the decision question and tolerance.

agency_deliverables.purpose: How the test is set up and rolled out across commerce, affiliate, media and platform teams so that treatment and comparison are clean.
tasks: Treatment vs comparison setup: comparison set and matched set defined, eligibility rules and SKU / region lists locked
Channel and affiliate rollout sequencing, so both groups switch cleanly
Coordination model across commerce, affiliate, media and platform teams, with a named contact in each
agency_deliverables.done_when: Both groups, the rollout order and every team's contact are documented and agreed.

agency_deliverables.purpose: A go / no-go gate. Nothing launches until each held-constant is confirmed and the treatment is verified live on the comparison set only.
tasks: Execution checklist: pre-launch, in-flight and close-out
Held-constant control plan: who confirms each item, how, and how often
Deployment confirmation: evidence the reduced offer is live on the comparison set and nowhere else before the read starts
agency_deliverables.done_when: Every enabler is confirmed in writing and deployment evidence is on file.

agency_deliverables.purpose: Running the test cleanly in market: tracking what is delivered and held, and escalating the moment a condition moves.
tasks: Weekly activation status: deployed, held, deviated
Deviation log: every change to a held-constant item or promotional mechanic, with date, group and affected SKUs
Execution QA: routing, tagging, listing-state and offer-display checks on both groups
agency_deliverables.done_when: Weekly status issued each week and every deviation logged and escalated.

agency_deliverables.purpose: What was delivered, what held, and whether the conditions were clean, then the next activation, conditional on the reconciled result. It does not give the causal verdict.
tasks: End-of-test activation readout: delivery, held-constants, deviations, test-condition cleanliness
Next activation recommendation, conditional on the reconciled result (not pre-decided)
Hand the conditions record to ShiftImpact for reconciliation
agency_deliverables.done_when: The readout is delivered and the conditions record has been handed to reconciliation.

client_platform_enablers.enabler: Pricing / discount approval (the single reduced depth)
client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: The one controlled variable exists and is accountable to the client.

client_platform_enablers.enabler: SKU eligibility and a fixed SKU set
client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: Comparison and matched groups are defined and stable.

client_platform_enablers.if_missing: Affected SKUs excluded; result may be inconclusive.

client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: Offer depth is not confounded with a list-price change.

client_platform_enablers.enabler: Affiliate budget approval, held at current level
client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: Budget is not a second variable.

client_platform_enablers.enabler: Platform permissions and access to listings and tracking
client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: Deployment confirmation and execution QA can be done.

client_platform_enablers.enabler: Data return (volume, margin, discount intensity, repeat, promotion log)
client_platform_enablers.makes_valid: Reconciliation can run on client-supplied figures.
The window can be agreed clear of events that would confound the read.
